features.description: File tools no longer follow a symlink swapped in after the permission check, closing an out-of-scope read/write hole.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed file tools (Read, Write, Edit) following a symlink swapped inside the working directory after the permission check, which could read or write outside the approved location

features.description: Marketplace plugin commands pointing outside the plugin directory are now rejected as path traversal.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed plugin commands declared in a marketplace entry being able to point outside the plugin directory; such paths are now rejected with a path-traversal error

features.description: Project settings can no longer enable raw API body logging or bypass a managed OTLP collector.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed project settings being able to enable detailed beta tracing or raw API body logging, and a lower-scope beta tracing endpoint bypassing an OTLP collector pinned by managed settings or a host app

features.description: Workflow tool no longer reads or quotes a scriptPath outside session-readable paths before permission checks run.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed the Workflow tool reading (and quoting in errors) a `scriptPath` outside what the session may read before the permission check ran

features.description: Grep and Glob now apply Read(...) deny rules to files reached through symlinked search paths.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Grep and Glob not applying `Read(...)` deny rules to files reached through a symlinked search path

features.description: Managed-settings disableAutoMode arriving mid-session now demotes a running auto-mode session to default mode.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed managed-settings `disableAutoMode` arriving mid-session not moving an already-running auto-mode session back to default mode

features.description: Bash commands assigning arithmetic expressions to integer shell variables now prompt instead of auto-approving.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving commands that assign an arithmetic expression to an integer shell variable (e.g. `OPTIND=1/0`, `RANDOM=2+2`); these now prompt for approval

features.description: Claude in Chrome browser actions now always route through Claude Code permission checks, not the extension's prompts.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed Claude in Chrome so browser actions always go through Claude Code's permission checks, including in sessions with telemetry disabled, which previously used the Chrome extension's own prompts

features.description: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL is now only a default; agent definition model: and per-spawn model take precedence.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` to set the default subagent model rather than override everything: an agent definition's `model:` and an explicit per-spawn model now take precedence over it

features.description: Default commit trailer becomes Co-Authored-By: Claude Code when the active model is not a recognized Claude model.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed the default commit trailer to `Co-Authored-By: Claude Code` when the active model isn't a recognized Claude model (e.g. third-party models behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`)

features.description: Sandboxed Bash commands can no longer redirect or replace the files their output is captured in.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed how Bash command output files are created and read back when commands run in the sandbox, so a sandboxed command cannot redirect or replace them

features.description: Project .claude/settings.json env can no longer set CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR, or TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed project-level `.claude/settings.json` `env` to no longer set `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR`, or `TMPDIR`/`TMP`/`TEMP`; set them in your shell, user, or managed settings instead

features.description: claude --help now documents attach, logs, stop, respawn, and rm for background sessions.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `attach`, `logs`, `stop`, `respawn`, and `rm` to `claude --help`; the `--resume` message for a running background session now names the exact `claude attach <id>` command

features.description: Server-managed settings that weaken sandbox isolation, terminate TLS, or inject credentials now require approval.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed server-managed settings that terminate sandbox TLS, route sandbox traffic through your own proxy, inject credentials, or weaken sandbox isolation to require approval before they apply

features.description: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS from managed or project settings now requires approval for credential or routing headers.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS` from managed or project settings to require approval when it sets a credential, org/tenant, routing, or API-behavior header (e.g. `Authorization`, `Host`)

features.description: New PreModelSwitch and PostModelSwitch hook events can block, confirm, or annotate a model switch.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `PreModelSwitch` and `PostModelSwitch` hook events (block, confirm, or annotate a model switch); `SessionStart` resume hooks now receive session staleness and the estimated re-cache cost

features.description: New rate_limits.spend_limit status line field for gateway users with spend limits.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a Spend limit bar to `/usage` and a `rate_limits.spend_limit` status line field for developers behind a Claude apps gateway with spend limits

features.description: New prompt_cache object for status line scripts exposing hit ratio, misses, re-cached tokens, and warm/cold.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a per-session prompt-cache line to `/cost` (hit ratio, misses, tokens re-cached, warm/cold) and a matching `prompt_cache` object for status line scripts
